info.title: API-DocTest-List Auto Insurance Quotes Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Status API allows users to check the status of their auto insurance quotes in real-time. It serves as a critical resource for individuals and businesses seeking to monitor the progress of their insurance applications. Typical consumers of this API include insurance agents and customers who want to stay informed about the status of their quotes. By providing timely updates, the API ensures transparency and enhances user engagement throughout the insurance purchasing process.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of quotes.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of various quotes. By using this API call, developers can integrate quote status checks into their applications, ensuring they have the latest update on their quotes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of quotes. It must contain the necessary information to process the request successfully.

200.description: The request was successful, and the status of the quotes has been retrieved.
